spaces_compareIntro: Before {name} holds anything here, compare a fingerprint.
spaces_compareWith: Compare these digits with what {name}’s Kemlock shows (Settings, Account security), group by group.
spaces_confirmHelp: Confirm only if every group matches. Keys are sealed to them once you do.
spaces_confirmWith: Compare {name}’s fingerprint with what their own Kemlock shows (Settings, Account security).
spaces_davHelp: A WebDAV space: everyone with its key reads and writes the whole file, and nobody can be removed.
spaces_differ: If the digits differ, someone else’s key may be in the way. Nothing was stored.
spaces_email: Email of the account to invite
spaces_err_action_busy: The space kept changing. Try again.
spaces_err_action_cantApply: That doesn’t fit the space as it is now.
spaces_err_action_homeAway: The space’s home server is away, so this waits for it.
spaces_err_action_notAllowed: Your role in this space doesn’t allow that.
spaces_err_dav_auth: The folder’s server refused that username or password.
spaces_err_dav_conflict: Another device was writing the file. Try again.
spaces_err_dav_format: That file isn’t a Kemlock sync file.
spaces_err_dav_insecure: The folder must be an https address.
spaces_err_dav_joined: You are in that space already.
spaces_err_dav_key: That invite’s key doesn’t open the space’s file.
spaces_err_dav_network: The folder’s server can’t be reached.
spaces_err_dav_noFile: The space’s file isn’t in that folder.
spaces_err_dav_older: The server handed back an older file than one already synced.
spaces_err_dav_server: The folder’s server answered with an error.
spaces_err_held_cantKeep: There is no accepted copy to keep. It can only be deleted.
spaces_err_held_keysPending: The space’s keys wait for their replacement.
spaces_err_held_notAllowed: Only a member who may edit can do that.
spaces_err_held_notHeld: The server doesn’t hold that item.
spaces_err_hidden: A login whose password this space hides can’t be moved: that would show the password.
spaces_err_invalid: That doesn’t make sense for this space.
spaces_err_lookup_malformed: The server’s answer about that account can’t be trusted.
spaces_err_lookup_none: No Kemlock account has that email.
spaces_err_lookup_notAllowed: Only an Owner, an Admin or a member who manages users may invite.
spaces_err_lookup_rateLimited: Too many lookups. Try again in a while.
spaces_err_mismatch: The fingerprint isn’t the one that was compared. Nothing was done.
spaces_err_notChecked: This space hasn’t been checked in this session yet. Refresh, then try again.
spaces_err_onlyOwner: You are its only Owner. Make another member an Owner first.
spaces_err_ownKey: The chain records another key for your account than the one this browser holds.
spaces_err_resend_notAllowed: You can’t send that invitation again.
spaces_err_resend_tooSoon: An invitation can be sent again every 10 minutes.
spaces_err_sync_cantBeChecked: This space can’t be checked: its chain of changes goes back, forks or isn’t signed by who it should be. Nothing of it was stored.
spaces_err_sync_keysPending: This space waits for its keys to be replaced.
spaces_err_sync_older: The server handed back an older copy of this space than you saw. Nothing was stored.
spaces_heldHelp: A held item was written under a key that was replaced. Keep writes the copy you accepted again; Delete removes it.
spaces_hiddenHelp: Your access hides passwords. That guards against onlookers and careless copying, not against a member: the key is yours.
spaces_homeAway: {home} is away, so changes to members, roles and keys wait for it. Items keep syncing.
spaces_inSpaceReadOnly: In the space {name}; you can only view it
spaces_inviteHelp: The invitation grants nothing and seals no key. They accept in their app, and you confirm them by comparing fingerprints.
spaces_inviteIntro: You are invited to {name}, with {count} members. Before you accept, compare a fingerprint.
spaces_joinHelp: Paste the invite (it starts with bmc-space:) and the one-time code its sender gave you, and say where the space’s folder is.
spaces_keysNeed: Keys need replacing after a removal. Writes to this space wait until an Owner or Admin does it on their phone.
spaces_leaveBody: Its items leave this browser and your other devices. You would need a new invitation to come back.
spaces_makeHelp: You become its Owner. It starts with one collection, Everyone. Invite people from its page; keys go to them only once you have compared their fingerprint.
spaces_noAccount: Shared spaces live on Kemlock Server. Sign in to it in Settings to see yours. WebDAV spaces can still be joined here.
spaces_none: You are not in any space yet.
spaces_notCompared: This space holds nothing here until you compare a fingerprint.
spaces_notSigned: The key the chain gives for them has signed nothing since you were admitted, so there is nothing to compare yet.
spaces_nothingToAdd: Nothing of yours is left to add.
spaces_nothingToCompare: Your own key vouches for this space; there is nobody to compare with.
spaces_onlyOwner: You are its only Owner. Make another member an Owner before you leave.
spaces_ownKey: The chain records another key for your account than the one this browser holds, so this is not the space it seems. Nothing was stored.
spaces_passwordHidden: The password is hidden by this space. Kemlock still fills it on its sites.
spaces_passwordHiddenEdit: The password is hidden by this space, so it stays as it is.
spaces_pickOwner: Pick an Owner to compare with.
spaces_policyMinLength: Master passwords of at least {length} characters
spaces_recoveryNotice: Account recovery is on here: the space’s admins could reset your master password and open your vault.
spaces_removed: Removed. The keys they held will need replacing.
spaces_status_moved: Moved to Kemlock Server, run by the phone
spaces_waiting: Waiting for an admin to confirm you. Read your fingerprint out to them.
